session.question: What spatial resolution and synchronization frequency were used to assimilate ocean observations into the digital twin?
session.answer: I cannot answer. The provided context states that the sources do not give any concrete spatial resolution or synchronization frequency values for assimilating ocean observations into the digital twin. Instead, they only describe the general concept that digital twins of the ocean are synchronized with the real ocean at a specific frequency and fidelity, and that they incorporate observations, historical data, and forecasts to represent past, present, and future states. No numerical assimilation settings are reported in either source. (bronner2023digitaltwinsof chunk 1, tzachor2023digitaltwinsa chunk 1)
